Exists because three consecutive ops/NIGHTLY-LOG.md entries (2026-09-19) recorded the same gap as a Did-not-go-well: no manifest existed, so coverage had to be inferred from commit messages naming rooms, not pages, which is imprecise.
_pre_manifest_note: Room-level mentions in ops/NIGHTLY-LOG.md before this file existed (2026-09-19 and earlier) named a roughly 49-of-114 sample across most rooms, but never at page granularity. That prior work is real but is NOT reflected as read:true below, because doing so would fabricate precision the log itself admits it does not have (CLAUDE.md 0.4: unknown is not unused). Treat pre-2026-09-19-manifest coverage as a soft prior, not a record.
